title: Keep Codex session rotate attached to top-level conversation
description: Codex emits conversation-start OTEL events for spawned sub-agents through the parent h2 collector. h2 can overwrite RuntimeConfig.harness_session_id and native_log_path_suffix with a child conversation, causing h2 session rotate to resume the child in a degraded/unattachable state. Preserve the top-level Codex conversation identity and rollout log across sub-agent starts; add regression coverage.

comments.author: fond-frost
comments.text: Implemented and self-reviewed: CodexHarness now classifies rollout session_meta.thread_source, pins the top-level conversation (including resume ID), and suppresses subagent conversation-start events before they reach RuntimeConfig persistence. Added a regression test proving a later subagent cannot replace the top-level rollout path or emit a second SessionStarted event. go test ./internal/session/agent/harness/codex and make check pass.
